hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Ambler, PA, and Baths Built by One Family
hero.subheadline: B&B Associates Creations is a father-and-son design-build firm that remodels complete kitchens and spa-style primary baths across Montgomery County, Bucks County and the Main Line. Owner Michael Barbulescu or co-founder Laurentiu Barbulescu oversees every job.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling in Ambler, PA by B&B Associates Creations: waterfall stone island with upholstered stools, warm wood lower cabinets, black glass-front uppers, brass globe pendants and a black range hood over gray tile

intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Ambler from a father-and-son team
paragraphs: B&B Associates Creations handles kitchen remodeling in Ambler, Maple Glen and the towns around them, along with full primary bathroom builds. Laurentiu Barbulescu and his son Michael started the company in Ambler in 2013. Michael now runs it as owner, his brother Andrei manages operations, and the office and warehouse sit on Welsh Road in Maple Glen.

The firm takes on complete kitchens and full bathrooms only, not repairs or cabinet refacing. One team designs and builds each room, and you see an itemized estimate before you sign. On Google, bathroom renovation is the topic reviewers mention most, and recent work runs from a sage and vanilla kitchen in Doylestown to a checkerboard-floor master bath in Pipersville.

services.h2: Complete kitchens, primary baths and the details inside them

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchens with custom cabinetry, quartzite, marble or granite counters, layered lighting and panel-ready appliances. In Doylestown, the crew paired vanilla perimeter cabinets with a painted sage island, Fantasy Brown counters and a microwave drawer. B&B's published range is $50,000 to $135,000, set mostly by kitchen size.

image.alt: Doylestown kitchen with vanilla painted upper cabinets, a sage green island with a Fantasy Brown stone top, bar stools, brass cone pendants and oak floors

items.name: Primary bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Master bath builds with custom vanities, frameless glass showers, freestanding tubs and radiant heated floors. The Ambler master bath added a seated makeup station, LED mirrors with defoggers and 24x48 slab tile over floor heat. Bathrooms run $20,000 to $75,000, and most take three to six weeks.

image.alt: Ambler master bathroom with a freestanding tub under a chandelier, white plantation shutters, a frameless glass corner shower and large marble-look slab floor tile

items.name: Custom cabinetry
items.blurb: Cabinets are sized to your room in painted, stained or specialty finishes, with soft-close hardware and hidden storage. The Bala Cynwyd kitchen shows the wood side of that work: natural maple stained cabinets run floor to ceiling and wrap a peninsula with bar seating, set against a marble backsplash.

image.alt: Bala Cynwyd kitchen with natural maple stained cabinets to the ceiling, a marble backsplash, white stone counters, an undermount sink and under-cabinet lighting

items.name: Tile showers and stonework
items.blurb: B&B's own crews set large-format porcelain, natural stone and mosaic tile, build curbless and walk-in showers over waterproofing membranes, and finish niches and benches. In Lansdale, Leida 24x48 porcelain wraps the floor and shower walls behind a custom frameless glass door with a built-in bench.

image.alt: Lansdale walk-in shower with marble-veined 24x48 porcelain walls, a built-in bench, a recessed niche, a mosaic floor and a brass-trimmed frameless glass enclosure

about.h2: Meet Michael Barbulescu and the B&B family
about.text: Michael Barbulescu co-founded B&B Associates Creations in 2013 with his father, Laurentiu, as 50/50 partners. They set out to bring honest craftsmanship back to remodeling, with no cut corners and no contractors who vanish mid-job. After a decade of building the company side by side, Michael took majority ownership and now leads its work across Montgomery County, Bucks County and the Main Line. His younger brother Andrei joined as operations manager, so the family oversees each project from the first design meeting to the final walkthrough. In Michael's words, every project "reflects our name." The family is now building a design showroom at its Welsh Road base.

image.alt: B&B Associates Creations crew lined up in matching shirts in front of the company's work vans and trucks

process.h2: How a B&B kitchen or bath comes together

steps.title: Free in-home consultation
steps.text: The owner meets you at home at no charge to learn your goals, how your household lives and what the new room needs to do.

steps.title: 3D design and selections
steps.text: You see full 3D renderings and choose materials from more than 60 supplier partners before any wall is opened, with an in-house design lead guiding you.

steps.title: Itemized estimate and permits
steps.text: You get a line-item estimate with no hidden fees. B&B files the permits, sets the schedule and books the township inspections.

steps.title: Build with one dedicated crew
steps.text: The same crew stays on your project every day until it is finished, and Laurentiu or Michael is on site instead of a manager you have never met.

steps.title: Walkthrough and owner follow-up
steps.text: You walk the finished room with your project manager, and the owner follows up personally afterward. Each project is backed by B&B's workmanship warranty.

service_area.h2: Serving Ambler, Blue Bell, Doylestown and the Main Line
service_area.text: B&B works from Maple Glen in Upper Dublin Township, and central Montgomery County is its primary area: Ambler, Blue Bell, North Wales, Lower Gwynedd, Fort Washington, Horsham, Flourtown and Lansdale. Crews also cover Bucks County towns such as Doylestown, Newtown, New Hope and Warminster, plus Main Line towns including Wayne, Villanova, Bryn Mawr and Gladwyne. The company puts Blue Bell about 8 minutes from its Welsh Road base and Doylestown about 22. Not sure your street is covered? Call (267) 402-8758.

faq.h2: Ambler kitchen and bath remodeling questions

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Ambler and Montgomery County?
items.a: B&B's published range for a complete kitchen is $50,000 to $135,000, driven mostly by size. Small kitchens run about $50,000 to $60,000, medium $60,000 to $75,000, large $75,000 to $90,000, and extra-large $90,000 to $135,000. Your exact number comes on a line-item estimate after the free in-home consultation.

items.q: What does a primary bathroom remodel cost, and how long does it take?
items.a: Bathrooms range from $20,000 to $75,000, with spa-style master baths at the top and hall or guest baths lower. Most bathroom projects take three to six weeks. A full master bath with custom tile usually runs five to seven weeks, and a powder room refresh can be done in about two.

items.q: How long does a full kitchen take, and how far ahead should I book?
items.a: Plan on about 12 to 20 weeks from first meeting to finished kitchen. That covers design, permits and 4 to 10 weeks of work in your home. B&B's schedule usually books 6 to 10 weeks past the consultation date, so spring projects are best started in January or February.

items.q: What kinds of projects does B&B take on?
items.a: Only complete kitchen renovations and full bathroom builds. The company does not take repairs, partial remodels, cabinet refacing, tub liners or whole-home renovations. It focuses on high-end, full-scope work in Montgomery County, Bucks County and the Main Line, and handles permits and inspections as part of every job.

items.q: Can I see cabinets, stone and tile in person before I choose?
items.a: Soon. B&B is building a design showroom at 1141 E Welsh Road with full-scale cabinet and countertop displays, tile, stone and fixtures from more than 60 supplier partners. The homepage lists the opening as Winter 2026 to 2027. Until it opens, selections happen during your in-home consultation and design meetings, with 3D renderings.

final_cta.h2: Ready to plan your Ambler kitchen or primary bath?
final_cta.text: Book a free in-home consultation and get a fully itemized estimate, or send photos of your current space through the short form.
